notes.title: Patch Note for version v0.7.2 (hotfix)
notes.content:
[list][*][p] Fixed a bug where the Exposed buff could accidentally make an invader invincible.
[/p][/*][*][p] The building UI is now shown when pressing ALT, even if it was previously hidden. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Note for version v0.7.1 (hotfix)
notes.content:
[h3]⚖️ Difficulty Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] At difficulty 5, the first map intersection now starts one step later to better match the intended challenge curve.
[/list]

[h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug from the previous release that greatly reduced randomization — runs now feel varied again.
[*] Fixed an issue where loading a saved game could cause the game to get stuck.
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when selling towers.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note for version v0.7.0
notes.content:
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Map seeds now have a greater impact on gameplay randomness. (A seed selection option will be added in a future update.)
[*] All towers now display the total gold they’ve generated in their stats menu.
[*] Towers can now be assigned primary, secondary, and tertiary targeting priorities for improved decision-making.
[/list]

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Midas Tower: Reduced range and shorter buff duration to bring its power more in line.
[*] Shotgun Tower: Increased effectiveness at close range (this was due to a bug where some pellets were not dealing damage).
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Combining Heart of Midas with HP-altering challenges no longer kills the commander.
[*] Cult Leader can no longer become immortal.
[*] Visual fixes for disabled towers (Tornado and Laser beams now properly deactivate).
[*] Tower stats no longer display rounding errors.
[*] Empowered tiles now save correctly.
[*] Armor values update properly whenever they change.
[*] Targeting priorities are now saved correctly.
[/list]

[h3]Work in Progress[/h3]
[list]
[*] Swedish localization (with language selection available in the settings menu).
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note for version v0.6.1 (hotfix)
notes.content:

[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note for version v0.5.2
notes.content:
[b]New commander: Abyss[/b]
Isolates enemies to which he deals increased damage
[list]
[*] Ability 1: Shadow Realm
[*] Ability 2: Into the Abyss
[*] Ability 3: Call of the Void
[/list]
[b]New tower: Desolator[/b]
Starting tower of Abyss. Mid range tower which automatically critically hits isolated invaders.

[b]Minor changes[/b]
Slight buffs to Orc Chieftain and Blizz.

notes.title: Patch Note for version v0.5.1
notes.content:
[h3]New commander: Blizz[/h3]
Chills invaders until they are frozen solid, which he can then shatter.
[list]
[*] Ability 1: Snowstorm
[*] Ability 2: Snap Freeze
[*] Ability 3: Shatter
[/list]

[h3]New tower: Obelisk of Winter[/h3]
Starting tower of Blizz. Low damage tower which applies chill to all invaders within range.

[h3]Changes to commander: Ember[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adds a third ability: Inferno
[*] Decreased the Flame Gauge requirement for Volcanic Eruption as well as its damage
[*] Decreased the cooldown of Ephemereal Flame but also decreased the applied buff duration
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note for version v0.5.0
notes.content:
[h3]New commander: Tinkerer [/h3]
Utilizes gathered scrap to tinker with modules and towers.

[list]
[*] Ability 1: Reforge module
[*] Ability 2: Craft module
[*] Ability 3: Adds a module slot to a tower or trap
[/list]

[h3]New tower: Bolt Blaster[/h3]
Starting tower of the Tinkerer.
Fires 3 projectiles per shot in a scatter pattern and starts off with 4 module slots.

notes.title: Patch Note for version v0.4.0
notes.content:
[h3]Minor changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Almost all floating texts are now using the new particle solution, improving performance
[*] Floating texts now animate differently depending on if it's a normal hit, critical hit or a heal
[*] Mesh and effect update to Tower of Midas, Bombardment Tower, Displacement Tower and Ice Launcher
[*] Added a fog of war effect for unexplored areas
[*] Added tower particle effects for Rapid Fire, Time Dilation and Nullification
[*] Added an adversary introduction overview when finishing act 1 and act 2
[*] Changed the main menu backdrops to be more thematic
[*] Added notification icons to unlocked commanders, towers, modules and artifacts
[*] Several bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note for version v0.3.0
notes.content:
[h3]Major change: Optimization overhaul[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized skeletal mesh performance
[*] Optimized widget rendering
[*] Optimized particle effect performance
[*] Optimized widget update performance
[*] Optimized destructible mesh performance
[/list]

[h3]Minor changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing Cult Leader to disappear, softlocking the game
[*] Fixed a bug which caused volcano tower to be upgraded
[*] Fixed a bug which caused the game to crash when gaining a certain achievement
[*] More minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note for version v0.2.1
notes.content:
[b]Bug fix:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixing projectiles not spawning sometimes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note for version v0.2.0
notes.content:
[h2]Major changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new commander: Ember (unlocked by completing the game as Orc Chieftain)
[*] Added a new tower: Tornado Tower (starting tower for Ember)
[/list]

[h2]Minor changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a more interactive and guiding tutorial
[*] Increased GUI clarity when gaining artifacts, modules and towers
[*] Changed challenges to give their reward immediately
[*] Removed permanent challenges, now they all have a maximum duration
[*] Added a proper loading bar to the loading screen
[*] Added a very short cutscene of the commander waking up
[*] Added more tooltips
[*] Displacement tower now applies a debuff to the teleported invader which prevents it to be teleported while it has the buff
[*] Improved the statistics menu
[*] Adversaries now give rewards when killed
[*] And lots of minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note for version v0.1.8
notes.content:
[h2]Major changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked the code framework for tower upgrades (sadly nothing which is directly visible in the game, but you will notice it since we now can add awesome upgrades even more quickly to the game!)
[/list]

[h2]Minor changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tower projectile effects now changes according to their upgrades
[*] Added positive and negative highlightning of key values for all tooltips
[*] Added hotkey for selecting tower which has an unspent skillpoint (default F)
[*] Range indicator now updates immediately upon being modified
[*] Enemy building health has been decreased by 33%
[*] Commander health and enemy damage all increased by a factor of 10 to allow for more granular enemy damage
[*] Destroyed building debris has calmed down and will no longer pretend to be tumbleweeds
[*] And more minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note for version v0.1.7
notes.content:
[h2]Major changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adds modules! Modules are items which can be placed in towers, making them stronger and/or changing their behavior
[*] Adds 3 new adversaries, one per act: General, Cult Leader and High Priestess
[*] A big rebalancing of artifacts
[/list]

[h2]Minor changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The player can now choose from 3 challenges when visiting a Challenge tile
[*] Updates to all invader portraits
[*] Added the possibility to pan the camera using middle mouse button
[*] Fixed issues causing chain lightning and plague spread effects to get stuck
[*] Enemies can no longer dodge magic attacks (laser beam, chain lightning, plague, tower of midas)
[*] Fixed a bug which sometimes caused the game to get stuck during loading
[*] Victory and defeat menus can now be hidden to allow inspection of your towers post-game
[*] And a lot more of minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note for version v0.1.6
notes.content:
[h2]Major changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Towers now level and upgrade independently of each other
[*] Towers are upgraded through an upgrade tree (which currently is lacking a lot of icons)
[/list]

[h2]Minor changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Able to see and read about tower buffs in the tower menu
[*] The artifact reward for completing a challenge is now visible in the Active challenges list
[*] Miniboss castles are now destroyed upon finishing a miniboss wave
[*] Pressing space starts the next wave
[*] Overhaul of all tower upgrades
[*] Game difficulty rebalancing
[*] Achievement difficulty rebalancing
[*] Improved effects for Chain Lightning Tower
[*] Improved effects for Devourer
[*] Improved effects when the Commander becomes healed (e.g. through a Health map tile)
[*] Minor bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note for version v0.1.5
notes.content:
[h2]Major changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added achievements (more achievements to come in the future!)
[*] Added meta progression: Completing achievements will unlock new towers, artifacts and, in the future, commanders
[*] Added a proper reward menu at the end of each wave
[*] Added GUI sounds to all GUI elements
[*] Added hotkey settings
[/list]

[h2]Minor changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gold is now gained at the end of each wave instead of from killing invaders
[*] The building health bar was remade to be less visually intrusive
[*] Improved clarity when exploring the map
[*] Minibosses now spawn from the miniboss tile
[*] Added camera rotation
[*] Lots of small bug fixes and clarity improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note for version v0.1.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added save and load functionality
[*]Added an encyclopedia of commanders, towers and artifacts
[*]Traps now attack invisible invaders
[*]Implemented a temporary workaround to prevent softlocking the game if an invader would get stuck
[*]Minibosses now get a proper introduction
[*]Decals, tower range and ability targeting is now visible even when the game is paused
[*]Building health is grayed out if they are invulnerable
[*]Added tower tags to their tooltips
[*]And several minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note for version 0.1.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added explore legend while exploring the map
[*] Added a brief tutorial at the beginning for new players
[*] Added highlighting of all towers (hotkey: Left ALT)
[*] Ability targeting now changes colour if it's uncastable (e.g. due to a lack of energy)
[*] Tower placement markers change if they belong to a building which has been destroyed
[*] Several minor bug fixes 
[/list]
